text: Gardening significantly reduces waste by utilizing organic materials such as leaves, grass clippings, and vegetable scraps to create nutrient-rich compost. This compost, when applied to the soil, enriches it and supports the growth of healthy plants. Furthermore, gardening encourages the use of mulch, which protects the soil from erosion, conserves moisture, and suppresses weeds. By adopting gardening practices, individuals can significantly reduce their waste output, promote sustainable gardening, and cultivate healthier plants.
summary: Gardening reduces waste, enriches soil with compost, and uses mulch for healthy plants.
